name: Ice Heart Regalia (Băng Tâm Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Keeper's Stillness (Chưởng Hồ Chi Tĩnh)
bonuses.rule: while you hold all three, the first time each fight you would fall below a quarter of your health, the foe's clock stops for 1.5 s (its arts, basic attack and companions wait; no damage taken, your arts recharge), and the foe gains 3 Ice stacks.

story: Tần held all three. The Mirror went to Tiết Hàn Mai in 820 for the Array's last nodes, and Sở Ngọc Hồ has never asked for it back. The Regalia is whole only in one pair of hands, so succession and Tiết's death decide who holds it.

name: Red and White Plums (Hồng Bạch Song Mai)

bonuses.rule: your Snow Plum cuts alternate swords; every fifth petal lands twice, and a petal that crits adds one more Ice stack.

story: Lãnh Hương Các's two plum swords and the cape of its last swordsman, Phó Thanh Mai. The red was lost at Cô Thành in 726. Phó Ám Hương wears the white and his father's cape, and the set is whole only if he takes the red back from Phượng Minh.

name: Glacier Vigil (Băng Bích Thủ Tịch)

bonuses.effect: The Peak Does Not Move (Phong Bất Động)
bonuses.rule: while your diagram is laid and you are Composed, your ward gains 3 % of its base value each second, with no ceiling; each second you stay Composed past the tenth costs you 1 % of your linh lực. When the foe breaks it (a shield breaks), the foe gains 4 Ice stacks and cannot evade for 1 s.

story: Two pieces from Tần Ngưng Sương, the banner from the Array's laying and the seal from her deathbed, and one Cố cut from her own cave wall. Cố has worn all three since 1010 and has not come down. Whoever she gives the seal to will learn the last order.

name: Ice-Fisher's Three (Băng Ngư Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Second Wind on the Ice (Băng Thượng Hồi Khí)
bonuses.rule: the first time each fight you fall below half health, you regain 20 % of your health and a quarter of your linh lực over 4 s, and your next five Snow Plum cuts each add one more Ice stack.

story: Made by the coast for its own man: the blade forged at Trấn Sa from a fisher's ice-cutter, the coat from Đoàn's family, the gourd refilled by the villages. Thẩm wears all three in the Hall of Cold Law so the inner halls see what the coast pays.

name: Keeper of the Lid (Thủ Cái Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: while you stand inside your own formation, every 6 s it regains 4 % of its strength and you gain an Earth guard stack. Once a fight, at 10 Earth guard stacks, your formation cannot be broken for 3 s.

story: Both cut from one locust tree of Hòe Âm, the wood sent by her childhood friend Thái Lê Tuyết when Tiết laid the Array's last nodes. She wears them with the Clear-Heart Mirror, which is the Keeper's, not hers.

name: Clear Glaze (Lưu Ly Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each time a foe reaches 5 Ice stacks from you, your next cut against it is a sure crit and its Cold damage ignores the foe's ward.

story: The sword and ring are the Keeper's gifts at her disciple's Kết Đan; the robe is Khương's own. She wears the set as an heir would, and asks every year why it is not the Regalia.

name: Step for Step (Bộ Bộ Tương Tùy)

bonuses.rule: while your ward holds, the Ice stacks you put on the foe last twice as long.

story: The robe she was found in and her master's first sword: the two things the Keeper has given anyone along with her surname.

name: Black and White Stones (Hắc Bạch Tử)

bonuses.rule: each time a foe gains its fourth Ice stack from you, it is also cursed for 3 s, and your curses on it count as Ice debuffs for your stack effect.

story: Made and won by her own hands, never issued by the Pavilion. A go player's pair: the white side shown, the black side kept.

name: Fisher's Heirs (Ngư Gia Song Kiện)

bonuses.rule: after 2 s Composed, you regenerate 1.5 % of your health and linh lực each second, and your next cut adds 2 Ice stacks.

story: One piece from his master and one from his grandmother, the Pavilion and the fallen sect. Liễu wears both and has told neither giver about the other.
